specsRaw.Quality: The 40mm 316L surgical grade stainless steel case provides the perfect size and materials for a robust, long lasting and reliable watch.
specsRaw.Limited Edition: The M.S.26 model is strictly limited to just 150 pieces. Each watch is individually numbered on the back. Watches will be sent out in numerical order on a first come first served basis.
specsRaw.Rated: 500m (1640ft), this watch performs perfectly for Diving, providing a reliable timepiece for confident time keeping.
specsRaw.Movement: The ETA F06.412 is a brass 3 jewel Swiss Made movement with a longer battery life and an EOL indicator, the movement includes the patented HEAVYDRIVE and PRECIDRIVE technologies.
specsRaw.Date Function: The ETA F06.412 movement includes a date feature for that extra touch and style.
specsRaw.Crown: 7mm screw down crown with 4 gaskets and the D1 logo.
specsRaw.Features: A Heliox escape valve is built into the watch case. This has been thoroughly tested by Paul Scurfa himself at different depths and gas mixtures, deepest decompression 154 metres to the surface.
specsRaw.Luminescence: Grade A Super Luminova SL-BGW9 is used to highlight the dial, hands and ceramic insert markers which glows blue in the dark.
specsRaw.Nylon Strap: The M.S.26 features an Admiralty Grey Defence Standard military specification nylon strap 1970’s style with the M.S.26 logo on the buckle.
specsRaw.Strap: The M.S.26 also comes with a blue 20mm rubber strap featuring a stainless steel buckle, based on the Italian leather straps seen on many vintage diving watches. The strong and durable rubber ensures your watch remains securely on your wrist.
specsRaw.Crystal: Domed sapphire crystal with blue anti reflective coating on the underside.
specsRaw.Storage Case: The M.S.26 comes in its very own custom made limited edition case unique to Scurfa Watches. The robust design ensures your watch reaches you in pristine condition.

specsRaw.Quality: The 40mm T2 Titanium brushed finish case provides the perfect size and materials for a robust, long lasting and reliable watch.
specsRaw.Limited Edition: The M.S.24 model is strictly limited to just 150 pieces. Each watch is individually numbered on the back. Watches will be sent out in numerical order on a first come first served basis.
specsRaw.Rated: 500m (1640ft), this watch performs perfectly for Diving, providing a reliable timepiece for confident time keeping.
specsRaw.Movement: The ETA F06.412 is a brass 3 jewel Swiss Made movement with a longer battery life and an EOL indicator, the movement includes the patented HEAVYDRIVE and PRECIDRIVE technologies.
specsRaw.Date Function: The ETA F06.412 movement includes a date feature for that extra touch and style.
specsRaw.Crown: 7mm screw down crown with 4 gaskets and the D1 logo.
specsRaw.Features: A Heliox escape valve is built into the watch case. This has been thoroughly tested by Paul Scurfa himself at different depths and gas mixtures, deepest decompression 154 metres to the surface.
specsRaw.Luminescence: Grade A Super Luminova SL-BGW9 is used to highlight the dial, hands and ceramic insert markers which glows blue in the dark.
specsRaw.Nylon Strap: The M.S.24 features a black charcoal nylon strap to make this a unique model in our range of diving watches.
specsRaw.Strap: The M.S.24 also comes with a black 20mm rubber strap featuring a titanium buckle, based on the Italian leather straps seen on many vintage diving watches. The strong and durable rubber ensures your watch remains securely on your wrist.
specsRaw.Crystal: Domed sapphire crystal with blue anti reflective coating on the underside.
specsRaw.Storage Case: The M.S.24 comes in its very own custom made limited edition case unique to Scurfa Watches. The robust design ensures your watch reaches you in pristine condition.

specsRaw.Quality: The 40mm T2 Titanium brushed finish case provides the perfect size and materials for a robust, long lasting and reliable watch.
specsRaw.Limited Edition: The M.S.23 model is strictly limited to just 100 pieces. Each watch is individually numbered on the back. Watches will be sent out in numerical order on a first come first served basis.
specsRaw.Rated: 500m (1640ft), this watch performs perfectly for Diving, providing a reliable timepiece for confident time keeping.
specsRaw.Movement: The ETA F06.412 is a brass 3 jewel Swiss Made movement with a longer battery life and an EOL indicator, the movement includes the patented HEAVYDRIVE and PRECIDRIVE technologies.
specsRaw.Date Function: The ETA F06.412 movement includes a date feature for that extra touch and style.
specsRaw.Crown: 7mm screw down crown with 4 gaskets and the D1 logo.
specsRaw.Features: A Heliox escape valve is built into the watch case. This has been thoroughly tested by Paul Scurfa himself at different depths and gas mixtures, deepest decompression 154 metres to the surface.
specsRaw.Luminescence: Grade A Super Luminova SL-BGW9 is used to highlight the dial, hands and bezel pearl which glows blue in the dark.
specsRaw.Nato Strap: The M.S.23 features an Admiralty Grey NATO strap to make this a unique model in our range of diving watches.
specsRaw.Strap: The M.S.23 also comes with a cobalt blue 20mm rubber strap featuring a titanium buckle, based on the Italian leather straps seen on many vintage diving watches. The strong and durable rubber ensures your watch remains securely on your wrist.
specsRaw.Crystal: Domed sapphire crystal with blue anti reflective coating on the underside.
specsRaw.Storage Case: The M.S.23 comes in its very own custom made limited edition case unique to Scurfa Watches. The robust design ensures your watch reaches you in pristine condition.

specsRaw.Quality: The 40mm T2 Titanium case and back with brushed finish provides the perfect size and materials for a robust, long lasting and reliable watch.
specsRaw.Rated: 500m (1640ft), this model features a 1mm case back gasket, providing a reliable timepiece for diving.
specsRaw.Movement: The Ronda 715SM is a gold plated 5 jewel Swiss made movement with a longer battery life and EOL indicator. This watch is designed for reliable timekeeping, even in the darkest ocean depths.
specsRaw.Crown: 7mm T2 Titanium screw down crown with 4 gaskets and the D1 logo.
specsRaw.Features: A Heliox escape valve is built into the watch T2 Titanium case. This has been thoroughly tested by Paul Scurfa himself at different depths and gas mixtures, deepest decompression 154 metres to the surface.
specsRaw.Luminescence: Grade A Super Luminova BGW9 highlights the dial, hands and bezel pearl which glows blue in the dark.
specsRaw.Strap: The 20mm rubber strap with T2 Titanium buckle is based on the Italian leather straps seen on many vintage diving watches. The strong and durable rubber ensures your watch remains securely on your wrist.
specsRaw.Crystal: Domed sapphire crystal with blue anti reflective coating on the underside.

specsRaw.Quality: The 40mm 316L surgical grade stainless steel case provides the perfect size and materials for a robust, long lasting and reliable watch.
specsRaw.Rated: 500m (1640ft), this watch performs perfectly for Diving, providing a reliable timepiece for confident time keeping.
specsRaw.Movement: Features an ETA F06.412 brass 3 jewel Swiss made movement with HeavyDrive anti-shock & PreciDrive thermo-compensating precision, longer battery life and an EOL indicator. This watch is designed for reliable timekeeping, even in the darkest ocean depths.
specsRaw.Date Function: The ETA F06.412 brass 3 jewel Swiss made movement includes a date feature for that extra touch of style.
specsRaw.Features: A Heliox escape valve is built into the watch case. This has been thoroughly tested by Paul Scurfa himself at different depths and gas mixtures, deepest decompression 154 metres to the surface.
specsRaw.Luminescence: Grade A Super Luminova BGW9 highlights the dial, hands and bezel markers which glows blue in the dark.
specsRaw.Strap: The 20mm rubber strap is based on the Italian leather straps seen on many vintage diving watches. The strong and durable rubber ensures your watch remains securely on your wrist.
specsRaw.Crystal: Domed sapphire crystal with blue anti reflective coating on the underside.

specsRaw.Quality: The 40mm 316L surgical grade stainless steel case provides the perfect size and materials for a robust, long lasting and reliable watch.
specsRaw.Limited Edition: The M.S.19 model is strictly limited to just 100 pieces. Each watch is individually numbered on the back. Watches will be sent out in numerical order on a first come first served basis.
specsRaw.Rated: 500m (1640ft), this model performs exactly as it should, providing a reliable timepiece for diving.
specsRaw.Movement: The Ronda 715SM is a gold plated 5 jewel Swiss made movement with a longer battery life and EOL indicator. This watch is designed for reliable timekeeping, even in the darkest ocean depths.
specsRaw.Date Function: The Ronda 715SM movement includes a date feature for that extra touch of style.
specsRaw.Features: A Heliox escape valve is built into the watch case. This has been thoroughly tested by Paul Scurfa himself at different depths and gas mixtures, deepest decompression 154 metres to the surface.
specsRaw.Luminescence: Grade A Super Luminova SL-BGW9 is used to highlight the dial, hands and bezel pearl which glows blue in the dark.
specsRaw.Strap: The M.S.19 features a grey Toxic NATO strap to make this a unique model in our range of diving watches. The strap features beautifully brushed steel metalwork to compliment the watches case.
specsRaw.Storage Case: The M.S.19 comes in its very own custom made limited edition case unique to Scurfa Watches. The robust design ensures your watch reaches you in pristine condition.

collections.name: Limited Edition
collections.description: Our limited edition watches are release only once a year and strictly limited to a maximum number of copies per watch. Each year these unique watches quickly sell out within the first few minutes of release. Be quick to secure your next limited edition Scurfa Watch…

collections.name: Diver One Stainless Steel
collections.description: The Diver One features surgical grade stainless steel case, aluminium bezel, sapphire crystal, large markers and luminous highlights to make this both a fully functional dive watch for extreme depths, as well as a fashionable watch for everyday life. The new diver one is an accumulation of over 12 years of wearing experience from work mates and contact with customers, it’s tested in an extreme environment and I’m sure you will be happy with the results.

collections.name: Diver One Titanium
collections.description: The Titanium version of our Diver One features a T2 Titanium case with a brushed finish, sapphire crystal, large markers and luminous highlights to make this both a fully functional dive watch for professional diving, a fantastic accessory for water sports, as well as a fashionable watch for everyday life. The new diver one is an accumulation of over 12 years of wearing experience from work mates and contact with customers, it’s tested in an extreme environment and I’m sure you will be happy with the results.

collections.name: The Archive
collections.description: The archive contains a comprehensive catalogue of past watches made and sold over the last few years. Take a look through our catalogue of historic watches to see how each watch has been extensively developed over the years.

collections.name: Bell Diver 1
collections.description: NEW FOR 2025… The Bell Diver 1 features an automatic movement for hassle free accurate time keeping. The design features large markers and luminous highlights to make this both functional and fashionable, the perfect choice for both extreme underwater environments and every day life on land.

collections.name: Top Side Crew
collections.description: The Top Side Crew is a stunning luxury watch designed for performance and style as an every day timepiece. Featuring a matt embossed dial, high quality brushed and polished stainless steel bumper bar case, Swiss made Ronda 715SM movement, sapphire crystal, Grade A Superluminova BGW9, and much more… the Top Side Crew stands out in every environment.
